identity.title: Identity Verification
identity.content1: KYC (Know Your Customer) is an identity verification and investigation process aimed at verifying the identity information and background of customers, ensuring that financial institutions or service providers comply with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT) regulations. It helps ensure account security and reduces the risks of fraud and illegal activities.
identity.title2: Why Do I Need to Conduct KYC Verification?
identity.content2: KYC is to protect the security and rights of your account. It safeguards your identity information and background, preventing others from using your identity for fraud or illegal activities.
identity.title3: I Encountered Problems During Identity Verification. How Can I Get Help?
identity.content3: If you encounter any problems during the KYC process, please seek help from our customer service. Our customer service team will be happy to provide you with support and answers. Please provide specific problems and relevant information so that we can help you complete the verification more quickly.

upload.title: Upload Photos
upload.error2: The picture must be less than 8MB!
upload.error3: Please upload all necessary document photos.
upload.tip1: Supports JPG, JPEG or PNG format pictures less than 8M.
upload.tip2: Document photos should be clear, without any modification or occlusion. The portrait, document number and name must be clearly visible.
upload.tip3: The photo should be taken without a hat. It is recommended not to wear makeup. The person holding the document should have clear facial features and fully expose their arms.
